# Exact standalone reconstruction: 43 actual common-diagonal stages, order 17
Save the block as rk17.js. Run `node rk17.js` with Node.js and standard-library Python 3. There are no package, external file or network dependencies. `node rk17.js --full` streams all 1,011,311 ordinary trees through 17. The embedded initial Python source is compressed only for length; `console.log(py)` displays it verbatim (core also printed uncompressed in the previous paid-reverse replay). The decimal guesses obtain dyadic centers only; interval rational certificates do not depend on assumed decimal accuracy. The directed zero diagnostics supplement the exact root/shift/Gram proof. The final 43-row A and weights are `ans17.A,ans17.b`, each interval an integer pair over 2^2048.
